# Sources pulled in by the extra Botan modules that rnp_experimental needs for
# PQC. Must stay in sync with the module list in third_party/openpgp.configure.
if CONFIG["NIGHTLY_BUILD"]:
    SOURCES += [
        "src/lib/hash/shake/shake.cpp",
        "src/lib/pubkey/curve448/curve448_gf.cpp",
        "src/lib/pubkey/curve448/curve448_scalar.cpp",
        "src/lib/pubkey/curve448/ed448/ed448.cpp",
        "src/lib/pubkey/curve448/ed448/ed448_internal.cpp",
        "src/lib/pubkey/curve448/x448/x448.cpp",
        "src/lib/pubkey/curve448/x448/x448_internal.cpp",
        "src/lib/pubkey/ec_group/legacy_ec_point/ec_inner_bn.cpp",
        "src/lib/pubkey/ec_group/legacy_ec_point/ec_point.cpp",
        "src/lib/pubkey/ec_group/legacy_ec_point/point_mul.cpp",
        "src/lib/pubkey/kyber/kyber_common/kyber.cpp",
        "src/lib/pubkey/kyber/kyber_common/kyber_algos.cpp",
        "src/lib/pubkey/kyber/kyber_common/kyber_constants.cpp",
        "src/lib/pubkey/kyber/kyber_common/kyber_keys.cpp",
        "src/lib/pubkey/kyber/ml_kem/ml_kem_impl.cpp",
        "src/lib/xof/shake_xof/shake_xof.cpp",
    ]

if CONFIG["CC_TYPE"] == "clang-cl":
    SOURCES += [
        "src/lib/utils/dyn_load/dyn_load.cpp",
    ]
